skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Synthesize relevant economic and financial knowledge for thesis topic.
Systematize specialized knowledge and integrate tools and scientific analysis methods to solve economic and financial problems.
Identify appropriate IT tools for solving economic and financial issues and determine additional knowledge requirements.
Understand economic and financial relationships through practical environments and phenomena.
Recognize practical problems that can be addressed with existing knowledge and propose solutions.
Explain the urgency of the problem and set research goals and questions.
Synthesize previous research and related tools to form a basis for implementation.
Apply learned knowledge and self-taught skills to calculate and solve economic and financial problems.
Analyze results and report findings accurately.
Evaluate results critically and propose policies for related issues.
Present and discuss to complete reports.
Present and defend opinions before a committee.
